verdict.rationale: Plaid IDV exposes webhook events (STEP_UPDATED, STATUS_UPDATED, RETRIED), granular risk assessments and an overall risk score, documented common failure reasons, and a retry API endpoint — all of which give an automated flow structured signals and outcomes to branch on. Missing for 10: explicit JSON schema/example payloads for verification results and independent/hands-on confirmation that these fields are reliably machine-parseable in production.
